title: Back cover
slide_intent: Mark the end of the guide with a single identifier so the final page leaves a clear visual reference to the publisher.
strategic_value: Voltera can close with the same circuit-pad signature that introduced the book.
demonstration: The white wordmark and small blue-and-white symbol sit low on a charcoal field. There is no printed heading or folio.
practical_value: Use this page as a reference for a quiet closing signature after a densely illustrated book.

content_islands.name: Closing signature
content_islands.spec: Center the small Voltera lockup horizontally near the bottom edge. Keep the rest of the charcoal field clear.
